answer: Each identity locks 70 credits, filing one ocean reading each dawn off its ridge station. Any peer may stake 24, claiming it hollow, reused or mismatched; auditors check the tide table. A confirmed claim burns the bond, pays 24; a false one burns the stake. First filing 25, kth 25+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,022,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-silence rings fail: a confirmed claim wins. Honest agents pay 25 once, keep their bond.
